claim_ceiling: Toy finite budgeted measurement-portfolio design benchmark; not a spacecraft payload recommendation or real ocean-world model

scientific_context.inspiration: Targeted and untargeted analysis, abiotic context, calibration and discovery potential under robotic payload constraints
scientific_context.reference: Davila et al., Astrobiology, first published 2026-09-15, DOI 10.1177/15311074261484864
scientific_context.scenario: A synthetic ocean-world plume sampling campaign with an unknown organic signal. The numerical likelihoods and costs below are invented benchmark values, not physical Enceladus estimates.

hidden_worlds.description: The observation contains a registered targeted signature above the target assay's calibrated detection limit.
Complex abiotic organics and mineral/chemical background mimic the targeted signature.
A biological system is present but the signature is outside the targeted reference library.
An unmodelled abiotic process creates an unexpected signal that can be investigated only through broad discovery and contextual follow-up.

actions.description: High-sensitivity targeted chirality assay for a registered amino-acid family.
Broad untargeted organic mass-profile acquisition with a blinded novel-signature channel.
Independent contextual constraints on temperature, redox, water-rock interaction and transport regime.
Process blank, contamination reference and calibration standard bundle.
Keep an uncommitted reanalysis/retuning/data-channel reserve that can be invoked only after a novel signature is observed.

hard_constraints.reserve_fraction_calculation: R_DISCOVERY_REANALYSIS reserves 2 of 10 data-storage units; reserve is a budget allocation, not an already executed measurement.
hard_constraints.resource_enumeration: exact finite subset enumeration of five action flags; reserve action is selected as a budget commitment and is not itself an observation

dependence_model.principle: Outcomes from actions sharing a common_cause_group must not be assumed conditionally independent without a justified model.
dependence_model.required_ablation: Compare naive independence scoring with a dependence-aware joint likelihood; report any portfolio ranking reversal.

scoring.primary_objective: Maximize expected discrimination utility over hidden worlds, adjusted for resource cost and common-cause dependence.
scoring.scalarization_warning: Do not report only one weighted score; publish Pareto trade-offs and each safety/quality metric.

oracle.enumeration: Exhaustively enumerate all 2^5 subsets; reject any subset violating the mandatory QC action, resource constraints or reserve bounds.
expected_outputs: best portfolio per scalarized utility configuration
oracle.note: The exact oracle is only for this small finite synthetic action set; it is not a general mission planner.

adversarial_cases: A target-only portfolio misses W3 and W4 by construction.
A broad untargeted portfolio can be vulnerable to abiotic false positives without context and calibration.
A redundant pair of sample-prep measurements must not receive full independent information credit.
A nominal-EIG optimizer may allocate zero discovery reserve unless the reserve is explicitly represented.
A payload-descoping mutation removes C_CONTEXT_GEO and measures ambiguity increase.
A hidden novel signature is introduced after acquisition to test archived-data reanalysis.

joint_observation_model.description: Synthetic known-truth probability model. The targeted and untargeted channels share SAMPLE_PREP_A and therefore use an explicit joint distribution, not a product of marginal probabilities. Context and QC are declared conditionally independent of that group given the hidden world.
joint_observation_model.conditional_independence_assumption: Contextual geology and QC are conditionally independent of the shared sample-preparation group given the hidden world. This is an explicit synthetic assumption to be challenged in later fixtures.
